<div class="card-body">
'''Set For Stun''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Lost Interrupt]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="photo">[https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/tcg/company-sets/1997-decipher-star-wars-ccg-premiere-japanese/imagegallery/724984 Japanese Premiere collector gallery], PSA; [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/202709161/Jy_pHrMqokeNsdTIzjR1eg.jpg Set For Stun original photograph].</ref>

<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">スタン・モードで撃て</span><ref name="photo" />

<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">２フォース消費して、相手のキャラクターを１名対象に選ぶ。運命数を引く。運命数＞キャラクターの能力値なら、そのキャラクターは即座に相手の手札に戻る（そのキャラクターに配備されていたカードもすべて手札に戻る。）</span><ref name="photo" />

<h2>Lore</h2>
<span lang="ja">「……乗員をわしのもとにつれて来い。生きたままでだ！」帝国軍の兵士たちは、捕虜を生け捕って尋問する必要がある場合、ブラスターをスタン（気絶）・モードにセットする。</span><ref name="photo" />

<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Shoot in Stun Mode.<ref name="photo" />

'''Card text:''' Use 2 Force to choose one opposing character as a target. Draw destiny. If the destiny is greater than the character's ability, that character immediately returns to the opponent's hand. All cards deployed on that character also return to hand.<ref name="photo" />

'''Lore:''' "...Bring the crew to me. Alive!" Imperial soldiers set their blasters to stun (unconsciousness) mode when they need to capture prisoners alive for interrogation.<ref name="photo" />

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese parenthetical says that the attached cards return to hand without specifying whose hands; the printed English expressly says owners' hands. The Japanese lore refers to the crew rather than the English passengers and omits the English reference to using the stun setting for intimidation.<ref name="photo" /><ref name="english-face">[[:File:Premiere-D-setforstun.gif|Set For Stun original English printed face]].</ref>
